label: v380
changes: AI connections can now bring supported original attachments into protected storage with a checksum, reported source and a review draft. Identical originals and retries reuse one file and draft.

Connection setup separates plugin installation from account authorisation, keeps reading existing saved documents optional for imports, and shows when an authenticated tool request has actually succeeded.
Your assistant can propose language and appearance preferences from your explicit request. Only you can approve them; later manual choices are preserved and other people’s profiles stay unchanged.
